numericScale.requirement: One canonical outcome per eligible number in stat/mastery wheels; normalize display aliases without creating extra sectors. Unresolved duplicate-number membership requires configuration, never bias from alias count.

contracts.order: Actual Equalizer result/reaction -> register future uniform-odds policy -> Backstory. Every subsequent actual mechanics wheel selects its valid pool, filters explicit guards, freezes uniform actual probabilities and draws the usual number of times.
contracts.defaultDifference: Normal equal-default only fills unspecified base weights before explicit distributions/lore modifiers. Equalizer is a character-owned override that forces final eligible probabilities uniform even when the ordinary profile is biased or fixed. Other characters retain their configured distributions.
contracts.noCatalogMutation: Replace the current invocation distribution only. Do not rewrite canonical ratios/normal Size templates/modifier definitions or a different character catalog. Record the suppressed ordinary profile references when available; an unconfigured lore-weight profile is not invented or calculated as a required counterfactual.
contracts.constraints: Probability equality does not remove structural eligibility. Apply hard minimum/maximum/guaranteed-grant/no-repeat/compatibility filters first, then equalize the remaining choices. Full0..9=10% each; constrained5..9=20% each; max-only9=100%. A zero probability caused only by ordinary lore/rarity weighting can become positive under Equalizer if still independently eligible; an explicit forbidden/disabled outcome remains excluded.
contracts.hierarchy: Uniform per actual wheel, not per all leaf paths or Tier1..5 groups. Do not flatten the event tree, invent a has-power/tier selector or balance unequal group counts. An actual pool None plus three allowed powers has four25% outcomes; a guaranteed-power wheel still excludes None before equalization.
contracts.fixedOverride: Equalizer is a named user-authorized distribution override, not an ordinary multiplicative modifier. Fixed-wheel allowModifiers:false and ordinary God80/20/Size shape protection do not block this policy on subsequent authorized invocations. No final ordinary group-mass/ratio postprocessor may reintroduce a bias after uniformization.
contracts.temporal: Do not apply to requester selection, original Race/events, the Archetype draw that selected Equalizer, or earlier frozen/committed invocations. Freeze each future wheel just in time with its active policy; source activation is part of the invocation proof. No retroactive reweighting/resampling on resume.
contracts.allLater: Includes event descendants, retries, authorized late acquisition/mastery slots and final-phase Enchant. Missing Weakness/Apex/Title catalogs remain configuration; equal odds do not invent their options. Fixed grants, image/meme/narration randomness and non-wheel calculations are not extra mechanics draws.
contracts.bonuses: Equalizer changes probabilities only. Retain all original grants/bonus sources and end-only bonus timing. Mastery remains per-active-weapon/one common power base, not one draw per power. God max is fixed instance override; Enchant still requires final effective Weapon Mastery>=5 and compatible unused slot.
contracts.gate: Reuse the existing accepted Race->Archetype eligibility gate and chosen role. This rule does not grant Archetype to God/Raksasa/other skipped races or authorize multiple roles. Strong race examples describe hypothetical stat bias, not new eligibility.
contracts.composition: A newly configured composite odds policy must explicitly declare compatible wheel variants/constraints. Once an otherwise-authorized wheel runs after active Equalizer, this uniform distribution has precedence over its weight biases. No additional Archetype/Gambler mode is inferred.
contracts.ledger: Freeze rule version, active Equalizer source invocation/spin ID, activation journal index, canonical wheel/options, eligible/disabled IDs and constraint proofs, uniform weights/probabilities and suppressed profile refs before drawing. Deduplicate activation and each actual source invocation; replay/media retries reuse frozen distributions/results.
contracts.reaction: Stack actual Equalizer source fact and known uniform distribution. Narrator may say semua peluang disamain. Unknown future results remain unknown; uniform odds does not make the actual rolled values identical. No caption-derived funny tag.
contracts.return: No immediate child spin. Continue to Backstory. Every later wheel/event retains its original saved caller and normal required stages; final bonus/Enchant/image ordering unchanged.
contracts.migration: Old frozen/committed wheels keep their original odds and seeded outcomes. New runs with active policy use equalizer/0.1.0; do not add Equalizer or rewrite old results.
contracts.loreMembership: Future ordinary stat lore profiles use weights over declared0..9 scale, not a preferred-band hard exclusion. Only separately approved true guarantees/compatibility may restrict membership; unresolved lore-vs-guard classification needs_configuration.
